recentItems.title: London Indian Film Festival presents the Goodness Gracious Me Reunion | BFI
recentItems.description:
At the 2026 London Indian Film Festival the cast and crew of Goodness Gracious Me - one of British television’s greatest comedy shows - visited BFI Southbank to talk about the show. 

After attracting audiences on BBC Radio Four, the 1998 TV version of Goodness Gracious Me became a popular success – watched and loved by millions. It delivered unforgettable characters, whose wry, wacky and often daring representations of British culture and UK Asian experience flipped stereotypes of British life from a South Asian perspective while poking fun at aspects of Asian culture in the UK.
